skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description: Devflow building block: grilling interview that also updates docs/GLOSSARY.md and ADRs. Use only when a devflow workflow calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: Interview primitive behind grill-me and grill-with-docs. Use only when one of those skills calls for it, or the user asks to be grilled.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.description: Challenge terms and record them in docs/GLOSSARY.md and ADRs in docs/adr/. Use only when grill-with-docs calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: to-spec
skills.description: Devflow building block: synthesize the conversation into a spec (GitHub issue + local .devflow/specs file). Use only when a devflow workflow calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.description: Devflow building block: split a spec into GitHub sub-issue tickets with blocking edges, lanes and footprints. Use only when a devflow workflow calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: implement
skills.description: Devflow building block: implement one spec or ticket inline with tdd, then spec-review. Use only when a devflow workflow calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: implement-spec
skills.description: Devflow building block: build fast-lane tickets in parallel worktrees onto an integration branch. Use only when run-lanes calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.description: Vocabulary reference for deep modules, interfaces and seams. Use only when tdd or another skill calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: spec-review
skills.description: Two-axis diff review (repo standards + fit with the spec) using parallel subagents. Use when a devflow workflow or implement calls for it, or the user asks to review a branch against its spec.

skills.name: setup-devflow-skills
skills.description: Configure this repo for devflow: issue tracker, triage labels and domain doc layout, kept in the git-ignored .devflow/agents/. Run once per repo before the first /dev-single or /dev-multi.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.description: Devflow building block: turn a spec (optionally one ticket) into an exact task-by-task plan. Use only when a devflow workflow calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.description: Devflow building block: execute a plan with a tester, a fresh implementer and a review per task. Use only when a devflow workflow calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.description: Reviewer-dispatch template used by subagent-driven-development. Use only when that skill calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.description: Create or verify an isolated git worktree and record baseline tests. Use only when a devflow workflow or another skill calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.description: Finish a branch: run tests, then merge, open a PR, or keep it, with confirmation. Use only when a devflow workflow or another skill calls for it, or the user asks for it by name.
